preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array a is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
Each element in the array a is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a list of n integers, one for each position in the array a.

Each output value is either -1 (indicating it's impossible to reach a position with opposite parity) or a positive integer representing the minimum number of moves required to reach a position with opposite parity.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (output[i] - output[j] != 0 for i != j))
postconditions.description: The output values are distinct, meaning no two positions require the same number of moves to reach a position with opposite parity.
